name: JewelsStore Chat Widget
author: richiyali

sections.description:
JewelsStore Chat Widget adds a floating chat widget to your website.

Core free features:
* Floating site chat widget.
* Widget appearance settings.
* Optional external AI service connection for reply generation.
* Optional WhatsApp quick-contact button.
* Optional Meta WhatsApp Cloud webhook integration.
* Agent instructions and knowledge fields.
* Basic multilingual interface texts.
* Optional aggregate installation insights after explicit opt-in.
* Optional concise upgrade-aware assistant mode for the external AI service.

Premium features such as advanced analytics, conversation history dashboard, lead capture workflows, advanced automation, multi-agent tools, exports, and licensing are provided by a separate premium add-on and are not included in this free plugin.

External services

This plugin can connect to external services when you enable the related options in the plugin settings.

  1. JewelsStore external AI service

* What it is used for: generating chat replies when the external AI option is enabled.
* What data is sent: the visitor message, site URL, plugin slug, plugin version, and the configured runtime agent payload such as agent name, instructions, knowledge, and optional page context.
* When data is sent: when a site visitor submits a chat message and the external AI option is enabled.
* Service provider: JewelsStore.
* Terms of use: https://jewelsstore.online/terms-and-conditions/
* Privacy policy: https://jewelsstore.online/privacy-policy/

  1. Meta / WhatsApp Cloud API

* What it is used for: receiving and sending WhatsApp messages through Meta when webhook integration is enabled and configured by the site owner.
* What data is sent: WhatsApp message payloads and outgoing reply messages to the Meta Graph API.
* When data is sent: only when the site owner enables Meta webhook mode and connects their Meta developer credentials.
* Service provider: Meta.
* Terms of service: https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms
* Privacy policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/

  1. JewelsStore installation insights service

* What it is used for: optionally refreshing aggregate installation insights shown inside the plugin settings page.
* What data is sent: site URL, administrator email, plugin slug, plugin version, WordPress version, PHP version, locale, timezone, server name, and a small diagnostics payload.
* When data is sent: only after the site owner explicitly enables the optional installation insights setting.
* Service provider: JewelsStore.
* Terms of use: https://jewelsstore.online/terms-and-conditions/
* Privacy policy: https://jewelsstore.online/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the jewelsstore-chat-widget folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from WordPress.org.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the JewelsStore Chat Widget admin menu.
  4. Configure the widget and, if desired, enable the external AI service and/or Meta webhook integration.
sections.faq:
Does the free plugin work without the premium add-on?

Yes. The free plugin works on its own.

Is an external service required?

No. The widget can be displayed without it. The external AI reply feature requires the external AI service to be enabled and configured.

Can I upgrade later?

Yes. Advanced features are available through the separate premium add-on.

Does the free version block basic chat help?

No. The free version can be configured to keep replies concise and mention upgrades when relevant, but it should still provide basic help.
